_totalWithdraw(address,address,uint256) uses a dangerous strict equality. Strict == comparisons on token/share balances or amounts can be brittle when actual received amounts differ from requested (the strategy decrements principal by REQUESTED, not RECEIVED, amounts — design decision). Confirm the equality cannot be bypassed/forced by dust or rounding.

Reentrancy in _withdrawInternal(address,uint256,address,address): external calls (AMM swap / vault / token transfers) occur before state variables (e.g. totalDeposited) are written. Guarded by AYieldStrategy nonReentrant, but cross-function / read-only reentrancy and CEI ordering should be confirmed against the market-swap flow.

Reentrancy in _totalWithdraw(address,address,uint256): external calls precede state writes (totalDeposited update). Part of the two-phase emergency withdrawal path; verify state is settled before the AMM/vault external interactions.

_updateWithdrawalStatus uses block.timestamp for the two-phase withdrawal window comparisons (currentTime >= initiatedAt + WAITING_PERIOD; currentTime <= initiatedAt + TOTAL_DURATION; currentTime > initiatedAt + TOTAL_DURATION). KEPT per audit policy: this protocol is time-driven (24h waiting / 48h execution window), so timestamp logic is load-bearing. Confirm the bounds cannot be straddled by miner timestamp drift near window edges.
